g.text: Rust inputs — exact opaque bytes, never an installer or build fallback
verified TLS / dated fixed component URLs
length / hash / request and response close
Five verified inputs or overall STOP
retain partial files, no cleanup deletion
Root plus writer OR reader<=2 owned FDs
Root/file devices need not be equal
No decoder, extraction, installer or child
No rustup, Python, SDK or Rust execution
Per-file work<=119s within global work end
one exclusive root; never reuse, repair or suffix
at most five fixed GETs, no redirect/retry/mirror
bounded binary chunks and strict headers
five full matches and successful root closure
any root collision, identity or close failure
changed bytes, short I/O or closure failure
